title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Pricing Schedule: Plan Fees, Billing Periods and Renewal Terms
content:
# Marlowe & Finch Unlimited — Pricing Schedule

This schedule sets the list fee, the billing period and the renewal terms of every Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan. The list fee is charged per billing period, in US dollars to the cent, on the first day of the period it pays for.

## Plan fees and periods

| Plan | List fee per billing period (USD) | Billing period | Renewal notice before an annual renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | 4.99 | 1 calendar month | 0 days (no notice is sent) |
| Unlimited Student Annual | 9.99 | 12 calendar months | 30 calendar days |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | 24.99 | 12 calendar months | 30 calendar days |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | 9.99 | 1 calendar month | 0 days (no notice is sent) |
| Unlimited Express Annual | 59.00 | 12 calendar months | 30 calendar days |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | 99.00 | 12 calendar months | 30 calendar days |

## Renewal terms common to every plan

| Term | Value on every Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan |
|---|---|
| Auto-renew at enrollment | On |
| When a renewal fee is charged | On the day after the current period ends |
| Fee charged on renewal | The plan's list fee in force on the renewal date |
| Notice before a list fee increase applies at renewal | 30 calendar days |

## Reading the schedule

- The two monthly plans, Unlimited Standard Monthly and Unlimited Express Monthly, run one-month periods and carry no renewal notice. The four annual plans run twelve-month periods and carry a renewal notice 30 calendar days before renewal.
- Unlimited Student Annual and Unlimited Express Monthly share the same list fee of 9.99, but one is billed once per twelve months and the other once per month.
- Because a renewal is charged at the list fee in force on the renewal date, the amount of the next renewal is read from this schedule as it stands on that date, not from the fee the member paid at enrollment.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A member on Unlimited Express Annual whose current period ends on a hypothetical 14 May is charged the renewal fee on 15 May, the day after the period ends; the renewal notice for that renewal falls 30 calendar days before the renewal. A member on Unlimited Standard Monthly receives no renewal notice, as the notice period for that plan is 0 days.
